reviews.title: Durable and well built. Survived a liquid disaster.
reviews.comment:
I have the green switch version.
Durable and Chroma lighting is excellent. Put O rings in the keys to dampen slightly. Key feeling and clicks are a matter of personal preference.
Spilled coffee on this one twice. I thought the keyboard was toast after the last disaster spill. Keys weren't functioning and the leds were out. I took it apart and rinsed it out the affected areas heavily with alcohol. Blew the liquid out with compressed air/compressor. Works fine now.
After taking it apart I could see how good the quality was. Keyboard backplate is actually solid metal.
2 screws under the top two rubber foot pads. Careful, the pads tear easily.
18+- screws under the keys. Remove the keys to find them all.
reviews.author: Scott C

reviews.title: Very good keyboard. Worth the price.
reviews.comment: It works fantastically. It is honestly more sensitive than I expected but the customization through Razers app make it feel personalized.
reviews.author: R. Dots.

reviews.title: Solid Keyboard
reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/D1PQENuZwPL.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/51bvDWNUeIL._SY256.jpg Fun RGB lighting, fully customizable colors within the Razer lighting program. Lighting program is easy to use with plenty of tutorials on installation. Can customize individual keys for different lighting when pressed. Extra macro buttons on the left will take some getting used to, but just imagine what all you can assign them as. Solid keyboard in terms of weight, back wings to lift up to have it at a slight angle. Keycaps nice and solid quality. These are soft and bubbly sounding in my opinion, not sharp and clicky.  In prior experience with Razer, the price is a bit up there, but I would wager its worth it.  Received on September 28th, 2025; will check back after a while to update review if needed.
reviews.author: Angel

reviews.title: great gaming keyboard
reviews.comment: This keyboard is awesome. I upgraded from the old blackwidow due to the old software no longer being supported. I have cerebral palsy but love playing games on my computer. These keyboards allow me to disable any and all keys I may inadvertently strike as I have limited control of my fingers on one hand. Makes gaming so much more enjoyable. The macro buttons work well too, as well as the argb lighting is a nice change from the solid green of the old model. Highly recommend, as the keys are a joy to punch.
reviews.author: Jake

reviews.title: Reliable quality as always
reviews.comment: I mean, it's Razer. Of course it's going to be good! My husband asked for this for Christmas. The color is bright, the letters in the keys are transparent so they're lit up - none of this trying to see which letter is which when the lights are dimmed. Quiet enough he's not annoying the heck out of me when he's in a typing frenzy. Setup was a breeze, he had it done before he even had a chance to curse and complain about it!
reviews.author: Spryte332
